name: pickling jar
caption: A pickling jar with a wide mouth, straight walls and a sealed base. A sealed base carries faceted walls; a short neck carries a flat lid. Faceted walls keep a constant thickness with a stepped shoulder. Overall width is 1.10 times depth; height is 0.90 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous dark brown, tan, cream color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
